welcome_message: Welcome, math whizzes! In this story, a war rages between the numbers. Long story short, it all started when '7' ate '9' during the olden days of Addition.'7' was able to do this by joining up with '2'. In retaliation,'6' and '1' teamed up and destroyed '7'. However, '2' remained undefeated. So '1', a master of 'Operamancy', created three new operations: Subtraction, Multiplication, and Division. Now, in the 20th cycle, you are the latest '7', trying to atone for your ancestor's sins by face new, formidable foes with your comrades!
level_select_instructions: Use W,A,S,D to move 'P'. 'E' to select a fight with an enemy. 'Q' to quit.
quit_message: Thanks for playing War Of Numbers!
